feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 August 2026 4:55pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 25 August 2026 at 4:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasionally strong wind for a time tonight.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the Norwegian Sea with a ridge to sea area Shannon. Shallow slow-moving low in sea area Plymouth.


##Wind##

East 3 or 4, imminently increasing 4 or 5, and occasionally 6 late evening and early tonight, decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming slight or moderate this evening, then slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain slowly spreading from the south overnight and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in places.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Soon becoming mostly fair, then rain developing Thursday afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
